_disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMONSTRATION VALUES. Not derived from any real hospital scheduling policy.
_horizon_note: The horizon is a safety cap on the demo, not a clinical concept -- it stops the clock from running past the end of a simulated shift. max_events_per_run is a second, independent safety valve: if a bug ever made the epoch-cancellation in simulation/clock.py stop working, this is what turns an infinite loop into a loud RuntimeError instead of a hung process.
